title: A Survey on Evaluation of Large Language Models
venue: ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology
best_for_zh: 设计评测套件或解读推理基准分数的读者。
one_line: A high-impact survey that turns “evaluate an LLM” into concrete choices about target, dataset, protocol, and metric.
把大模型评测拆成评什么、在哪里评、怎样评的高影响力综述。
why: It prevents reasoning-data projects from treating one benchmark score as a complete capability claim.
inclusion_reason: A highly cited survey with CMU, PKU, and Microsoft Research Asia affiliations that makes evaluation conditions visible for reasoning-data work.

title: Problem
问题
html: Large language models can look capable on a benchmark while failing under a different prompt, a different grader, or a real task condition. The problem is not only finding more tests; it is deciding what the test result means. This survey organizes the evaluation literature around three questions: what should be evaluated, where should it be evaluated, and how should it be evaluated? For reasoning data, that means a question-answer pair is never sufficient documentation by itself.
大语言模型可能在某个基准上看起来很强，却在不同提示、不同评分器或真实任务条件下失败。问题不只是增加更多测试，而是决定测试结果意味着什么。该综述围绕三个问题组织评测文献：评什么、在哪里评、怎样评？对推理数据而言，这意味着一组问答本身从来不足以构成完整文档。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core idea is a three-part evaluation frame. “What” names the target capability or risk. “Where” identifies the task, dataset, and benchmark context. “How” specifies prompts, protocol, metric, and grader. Keep all three parts together when reading a score. A reasoning benchmark can be valid for arithmetic correctness yet say little about factual support, tool use, or robustness. The frame turns an impressive number into a bounded claim that another reader can inspect.
核心思想是三部分评测框架。“What”命名目标能力或风险；“Where”指出任务、数据集和基准语境；“How”规定提示、协议、指标和评分器。读一个分数时要把三者放在一起。一个推理基准可能有效测量算术正确性，却几乎不说明事实支撑、工具使用或鲁棒性。该框架把亮眼数字变成另一个读者可检查的有边界主张。

title: Method
方法
html: This paper is a survey and resource collection. Apply its method by writing an evaluation sheet before running a model: state the claim, select a dataset matched to that claim, lock the prompting and sampling conditions, and specify the scorer. Record failures as well as aggregate success. In reasoning tasks, include whether a model can call tools, see demonstrations, retry, or use external evidence. Those choices are part of the experiment, not incidental implementation details.
这篇论文是综述和资源集合。可在运行模型前采用它的方法写一张评测表：写清主张，选择匹配主张的数据集，固定提示和采样条件，并规定评分器；同时记录失败而不只记录总成功率。在推理任务中，还要注明模型能否调用工具、看到示例、重试或使用外部证据。这些选择属于实验本身，不是无关紧要的实现细节。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper’s evidence is its broad synthesis of tasks, benchmarks, protocols, success cases, and failure cases. Its official abstract explicitly includes reasoning among the evaluation areas and treats datasets and benchmarks as central components. This supports using the survey as an entry point, not as proof that every listed benchmark remains reliable. A meaningful evaluation report exposes the model version, prompt, decoding, data version, scorer, and uncertainty rather than presenting only a final mean.
论文的证据是对任务、基准、协议、成功案例和失败案例的广泛综合。官方摘要明确把推理列为评测领域之一，并把数据集和基准视为核心组成。这支持把综述当作入口，而不能证明其中每个基准仍然可靠。一份有意义的评测报告应展示模型版本、提示、解码、数据版本、评分器和不确定性，而不只给最终平均分。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The contribution is not a single new test. It unifies a fragmented field with the what-where-how lens and keeps task coverage, benchmark choice, and evaluation protocol in one discussion. That matters for reasoning-data research because data can be high quality for one target and misleading for another. The survey also makes failure analysis first-class: a model score should be read beside the kinds of examples it misses, not only beside competing models.
贡献不在于单一新测试，而在于用 what-where-how 视角统一碎片化领域，并把任务覆盖、基准选择和评测协议放进同一讨论。这对推理数据研究很重要，因为数据对一个目标可能高质量，对另一个目标却可能误导。综述也让失败分析成为一等内容：模型分数应同它遗漏的样例类型一起阅读，而不是只同竞争模型并列。

title: Limitations
局限
html: No survey can freeze a fast-moving benchmark ecosystem. Models change, public test sets may overlap with later training data, and model-based graders introduce their own preferences. The taxonomy tells you what to document, but it does not replace controlled experiments or human inspection where stakes are high. Do not infer causal explanations from a score difference alone. Check whether the prompt, examples, budget, and scoring rule were held fixed before attributing a gain to reasoning.
没有任何综述能冻结快速变化的基准生态。模型会变化，公开测试集可能同后续训练数据重叠，基于模型的评分器也有自身偏好。分类告诉你该记录什么，却不能替代受控实验，也不能替代高风险场景下的人类检查。不要仅凭分数差异推出因果解释。在把提升归因于推理前，检查提示、样例、预算和评分规则是否保持不变。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey to turn a vague evaluation plan into a testable one. Instead of writing “evaluate reasoning,” write the target behavior, the scenario, the allowed resources, and the metric. Then choose at least one diagnostic slice that can reveal a known failure, such as evidence absence, longer contexts, adversarial wording, or changed tool access. Students can reuse this structure for a data card: each row should say what the item tests and why the chosen score is adequate.
可用这篇综述把模糊评测计划变成可检验计划。不要只写“评估推理”，而要写目标行为、场景、允许资源和指标；再选择至少一个能暴露已知失败的诊断切片，如缺少证据、更长上下文、对抗表述或改变工具权限。学生也可把此结构用于数据卡：每一行都应说明样本测试什么，以及为何所选分数足够。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the three questions as a checklist, then apply it to one published reasoning result. If you cannot recover all three parts, mark the conclusion as narrow rather than general. Follow the benchmark and protocol sections with special care: they show why a dataset name is not an evaluation design. The lasting takeaway is practical. Better evaluation begins before inference, when you define what failure would disprove the capability claim you hope to make.
把三个问题当作清单阅读，然后用它检查一项已发表的推理结果。如果不能找回三部分全部内容，就把结论标记为狭窄而非普遍。要特别仔细读基准和协议部分：它们说明数据集名称本身不是评测设计。最持久的收获很实用：更好的评测在推理运行前就开始了，即先定义什么失败会推翻你希望提出的能力主张。
